content:
maya: Quick one 1: Hummingbird Health pilot on Redwood Dedicated went well. Product wants a short case write-up + a 30-min webinar slot. Need quote approval, logo permission, and legal sign-off (they handle PHI).
leo: great. do we have any hard perf numbers we can publish?
anika: we have internal numbers from the sandbox run but customer asked for a review before anything public. they also want to review the blog draft and speaker list.
maya: i'll draft two quote options and escalate legal. tagging @samir for perf confirmation and @legal-bot for compliance. timeline: aim to publish in 12 days. can legal review in 4 business days?
samir: numbers are: median latency down from ~320ms to ~95ms during steady-state tests, cost per inference roughly halved on Dedicated. i'm comfortable with a conservative quote.
olivia: safer to avoid raw patient-level language and any exact dataset references. legal will want DPA and logo usage clause.
legal-bot: Requirements: no PHI or screenshots containing identifiers, include reference to DPA, and require explicit emailed approval for any customer quotes/logos. Provide sanitized assets only.
maya: draft quote 1 (specific):
```
"Hummingbird Health: Using Redwood Dedicated, we reduced median inference latency from ~320ms to ~95ms and cut inference costs by ~50%, unlocking clinician-facing features."
```
draft quote 2 (high level):
```
"Hummingbird Health: Redwood Dedicated significantly reduced our inference latency and infrastructure costs, enabling new clinician workflows."
```
which should we send?
samir: vote for quote 2 to keep it simple.
anika: agree quote 2; offer to draft a gated technical appendix if they want numbers published to customers.
maya: sending quote 2 + logo request + ask about a small sanitized PNG of the throughput chart.
ops: can produce a redacted PNG without timestamps or IDs. will have by EOD tomorrow.
Hummingbird-Contact: (customer) Thanks Maya. We can approve the high-level quote and provide a logo. We won't allow dashboard GIFs; a redacted PNG is fine. We also request to review the final blog copy before posting.
legal-bot: Add this logo permission language: "Hummingbird Health grants Redwood Inference a non-exclusive right to use Hummingbird Health's name and logo in marketing materials related to the engagement, subject to Hummingbird's approval of final assets and compliance with the DPA." Require customer to respond by email.
leo: I'll draft the webinar run-of-show and reach out to product for a moderator.
maya: got customer email approval (forwarded). logo JPG attached. they confirmed that Dr. Lee (Head of ML) will join the webinar panel.
olivia: legal, can you review final copy + confirm DPA reference wording?
legal-bot: Approved with minor edits: remove any percentage claims unless customer confirms via email. Since they already approved high-level quote, remove the part about percent numbers in any public material.
samir: updating quote per legal: "Hummingbird Health: Redwood Dedicated significantly reduced our inference latency and infrastructure costs, enabling new clinician workflows."
maya: final copy sent to Hummingbird for quick sign-off with the attached assets. asked for webinar bio for Dr. Lee.
Hummingbird-Contact: (customer) Approved final copy and logo. Dr. Lee bio: "Dr. Hye Lee, Head of ML, Hummingbird Health. Focus on real-time prediction for clinical triage." Will do a 20-min talk + 10-min q&a.
anika: ops PNG uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood/hummingbird/case-assets (sanitized).
maya: checklist: 1) customer email approval (done) 2) logo + assets in folder (done) 3) legal sign-off (done) 4) webinar speaker confirmed (done) 5) blog draft & hero assets (in progress). aiming to publish in 10 business days.
leo: scheduling rehearsal Thu. sending draft promo copy to social.
maya: thanks all, locking this thread as canonical for approvals. will update when blog goes live. :white_check_mark:
